description: Inner-benchmark tasks consumed by the PromptPotter connector's extract_experiment hook. Each task is one inner-cycle invocation; the outer L1's score for a candidate is composited (per campaign.json::scoring) over the three proxy metrics produced per task: first_round_delta, after_N_rounds_delta, rounds_to_N — all now measured on subset-invariant ABILITY (θ-implied accuracy on the inner cycle's fixed δ ruler, RP-2) so a lucky thin resubset can't inflate the meta-fitness. Inner benchmark = justlogic depth-6/7 (~0.44 origin, clear headroom; gsm8k retired — its origin aces target). Target 0.60 (not 0.80) so rounds_to_N varies rather than saturating at the unreached sentinel — the paper ceiling on this stratum is ~0.81. n_samples_per_inner_round = 32 (RP-1): at 16 the inner θ_se (~0.5) exceeded a real +6% gain (θ~0.32) so the LCB winner election never crowned and every inner run flatlined at origin → the outer got zero signal; 32 halves the noise (se~0.35) so a GENUINE (>=2-sample) inner improvement crowns while a 1-sample fluctuation still (correctly) doesn't. Kept at 2 inner rounds to stay inside the $1 outer spend cap (32x2 fits; 32x3 would over-probe the budget — RP-3 3rd-round is the deferred next lever, raise spend_budget with it). PANEL SIZE = 8 seeds: the θ-LCB winner election needs >= elimination_n_min (6) covered samples to crown; 8 gives a 2-failure margin so one flaky inner tail doesn't drop effective n below the floor and waste the run.
